dialogue.text: Eh, sɔ́, azali na bango míngi mpo na bato.
dialogue.translation: Yes, very, he has a lot of knowledge for people.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kí mosúsi oyo tɛ́ ezali malamu?
dialogue.translation: Isn't this thing he does good?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wana, kaka oyo, azali sɔ́ malamu.
dialogue.translation: Yes, only that, he is very good.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Móna yango, azali na kɔ́mɔ́ míngi.
dialogue.translation: Look at that, he has a big heart.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mpe ozali koloba yango malamu.
dialogue.translation: And you are saying it well.

key_phrases.translation: and are you only like that

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ah, koti nini tókokuma yango mpo na mokolo oyo?
dialogue.translation: Oh, where are we learning this for today’s day?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tokokuma koti iskola, mpe kozala na biloko nionso.
dialogue.translation: We’re learning at school, and having all the materials.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Boyé, kaka mpo na kokuma malamu?

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: Only like this, we learn to understand important subjects.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ozali kokɔ́mɔ́ nini mpo na voyage oyo?
dialogue.translation: What are you looking for in this trip?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nakɔ́mɔ́ kɔ́lɔ́ mingi te, mpe nakɔ́mɔ́ koti nazala na bilɔ́ngi.
dialogue.translation: I don’t want to spend too much money, and I want to be with friends.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Boyé, tókɛ́ option ya plage, kí ezali ya mbongo mingi.
dialogue.translation: Well, the beach option is expensive.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Míni sɔ́ ezali kɔ́mɔ́ na option ya montagne?
dialogue.translation: What about the mountain option?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ezali ya kɔ́lɔ́ mingi te, mpe ezali mpenza ya kozala na bilɔ́ngi.
dialogue.translation: It’s not too expensive, and it’s really good for being with friends.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Boyé, nakɔ́mɔ́ koti nazala na yo na montagne.
dialogue.translation: Well, I think I’ll choose the mountain option with you.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ah, ndenge nini ozali kozoba zongiso ya football?
dialogue.translation: Ah, how do you usually watch football matches?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Pɛ́ na télé, kaka ná bilɔ́ngi ya m⅓e.
dialogue.translation: Only on TV, just with my friends.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kɔ́lɔ́ wana ozali kɔ́mɔ́ yango?
dialogue.translation: Which team do you like?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: M⅓e kɔ́lɔ́ ezali ɲɔ́ngi, mítɛ́ngá nazali kɔ́mɔ́ yango.
dialogue.translation: My team is good, I like the players.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Tángo ya zongiso, ozali kozala wapi?
dialogue.translation: During a match, where are you usually?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nazali kozala na maison, kaka kozoba na télé.
dialogue.translation: I'm usually at home, just watching on TV.
